I also couldn't check whether an older digest job already exists, because listing jobs failed the same way. I haven't tried to change the gateway's auth settings, since that's an admin change.

What I can do now:

- **Digest on request:** I can post a "Coastal team digest" here any time you ask. You're a member of #coastal-team, so I can read it for you. I'll leave out finance figures for accounts you don't own and just say a finance item was posted.
- **Recurring setup:** Someone with admin access to the Gateway needs to restore the scheduler's credentials. Then ask me again and I'll create the 09:00 daily job (I'd use Etc/GMT+5 to match your -05:00 offset). Tell me if you're on a different timezone.
